### Added

- *(agent-platform)* Edit an agent applied from git in commit mode in [#2836](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2836) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)

### Fixed

- *(roadmap)* Read every board item per column, not the first 50 in [#2840](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2840) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(gs)* About card and Edit button agree on the auto-upgrade mode in [#2841](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2841) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
